While the package uses prebuilt binaries (which inherently limits auditability of the actual code), this is a common and accepted practice for AUR packages distributing closed-source or cross-compiled applications. The sources are pinned to specific release versions (not mutable branches), and checksums are provided for all architectures. No dynamic downloads, eval usage, or unauthorized file operations are present in the metadata. Therefore, based on the information in `.SRCINFO`, there is no evidence of malicious behavior.
</details>
